statement.p: Find parametric equations for the arc of a circle of radius 5 from P=(0,0) to Q=(10,0).

static.solution: PQ has length 10, so it must be a diameter of the circle. The center of the circle is therefore the midpoint of PQ, which is the point (5,0). The upper arc of the circle between P and Q can be parameterized as follows: \vec r (t) = 5\vec i + 5(-\cos t \vec i + \sin t \vec j), \quad 0 \le t \le \pi. The lower arc can be parameterized as follows: \vec r (t) = 5\vec i + 5(\cos t \vec i + \sin t \vec j), \quad \pi \le t \le 2\pi.
